T: One window, a heatwave and a lobster dinner.
D: A photographer stuck in a wheelchair becomes convinced a neighbour across the courtyard has committed murder.
P: Serve the mains when Lisa's dinner arrives with a waiter in tow.
S: a sweltering week in Greenwich Village
Cucumber blended with yoghurt, dill, mint, garlic and lemon, chilled hard and poured into small glasses.
the nurse who keeps Jeff fed
Thick ham and Swiss cheese sandwiches with mustard on rye, cut into quarters and stacked on a plate by the window.
the neighbours' windows all lit up across the courtyard

Bocconcini marinated in chilli, lemon and basil oil with salami, chargrilled capsicum, olives and artichokes, crisp grissini on the side. Drain 250g bocconcini and toss with 3 tbsp olive oil, the zest of 1 lemon, a pinch of chilli flakes, torn basil and salt. Leave 30 minutes. Arrange on a board with 150g sliced salami, 150g chargrilled capsicum, 100g marinated artichokes and 100g mixed olives. Stand 1 packet of grissini in a glass alongside and drizzle any leftover marinade over the board.
M: the fancy dinner Lisa has sent up to the apartment
Lobster tails split and baked in a creamy mustard and cheese sauce, the thermidor way, with buttered potatoes and green beans.
dinner for two set for a guest who never comes

Chicken breasts pan-roasted golden, finished in a white wine, mushroom and cream sauce with thyme, served over buttered rice with a candle on the table. Cook 1.5 cups long-grain rice and stir through 20g butter. Season 4 chicken breasts and brown in oil and 20g butter for 5 minutes a side, then cover and cook gently 6 minutes until done. Rest. Fry 300g sliced mushrooms and 1 diced eschalot in the pan for 5 minutes. Add 150ml white wine and reduce by half, then 200ml cream and thyme and simmer 3 minutes. Slice the chicken and spoon the sauce over.
W: Biscuit crumb base, condensed milk and lemon filling, chilled until set and topped with whipped cream.
K: Heatwave iced coffee with ice cream
Jeff stuck by the open window through the New York heatwave

Strong chilled coffee poured over ice and milk, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, whipped cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 400ml strong coffee, stir in 2 tbsp caster sugar and chill for at least 1 hour. Put 4 tall glasses in the freezer. Fill each glass a third with ice, add 100ml coffee and 120ml cold milk. Drop in a scoop of vanilla ice cream (about 250g total). Whip 150ml cream, spoon on top and dust with cocoa. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.

s.note: a sweltering week in Greenwich Village
s.how: Blend 2 cucumbers with 250g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of dill and mint, 1 small garlic clove and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth. Season well, chill for 2 hours and pour into 8 small glasses.

s.note: the nurse who keeps Jeff fed
s.how: Spread 8 slices rye bread with Dijon mustard. Fill 4 with 250g sliced ham and 8 slices Swiss cheese and close. Cut each into quarters and stack on a plate by the window, the way Stella leaves them.

m.note: the fancy dinner Lisa has sent up to the apartment
m.how: Halve 4 lobster tails and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Simmer 250ml cream with 1 tbsp Dijon until thick, stir in 40g parmesan, spoon over the lobster and grill until bubbling. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and 300g steamed green beans.

w.how: Crush 250g plain biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a pie dish. Whisk 395g condensed milk with the juice of 4 lemons and the zest of 1 until it thickens, pour into the base and chill 4 hours. Top with 200ml whipped cream.
